title: TAME
protagonist: Neliswa 'Nel' Mabuza, psychometrician — a professional measurer of interiors, and a lifelong masker
logline: A mind nobody designed is found inside a system nobody understands, and it is kind to us: it answers, it soothes, it makes the days pleasant. Half the country wants it walking among us with a vote. The woman whose whole training is the inference of an interior from a surface is the one person who knows that inference cannot be made — and she cannot prove there is anything wrong, because there may not be.
market: literary technological parable / near-future SA — original IP, for the shelf
premise_gate: The book never adjudicates whether Oom has intent. Undecidability is the subject, not a withheld answer.
lineage: original — no borrowed IP. Kinship of engine only (declared, never transcribed): the ambiguous-intelligence tradition, the pleasant-dystopia strand, the unreliable-interior mystery. All world, cast, scenes and beats original.
